# Yu-Yun Chang

Ph.D. Candidate in Economics  
CUNY Graduate Center

**Model Risk · Quantitative Validation · Macro-Financial Forecasting**

My research focuses on exchange-rate dynamics, macro-financial forecasting, time-series econometrics, and machine learning. I am also building applied projects in model validation, data governance, and AI model risk.

## Research

### Beyond Data Release Timing: Information Alignment and the Measurement of Exchange-Rate Predictability

*Job Market Paper*

This paper studies how the construction of the historical information set affects measured exchange-rate predictability, with particular attention to publication timing, forecast-origin information, and contemporaneous financial-market information.
